Dear [Miss Benson](../persons.html#1858)
I have sent up your joint story, for which I thank you much, to have the length of pages calculated.

If it goes in, it will stand first before a sad and true scene in a secularised hospital at Paris by [Madame de Witt](../persons.html#423) so as to shew the fruits of the cult of humanity without its Master.

But I am not sure that I can get it in, and I also think that though it is rather long for the purpose, it might for its own sake and that of the idea be longer so that I shall not so much regret if it has to be sacrificed

Yours truly

C M Yonge
